The '''Seventeenth Army''', also known as '''Chrome Shield Command''', was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and later [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Army]] charged with the defense of the [[Dustig Oversector]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

During the Clone Wars, the 17th Sector Army defended a salient around Malastare, and also reinforced the [[Eighteenth Army|18th Sector Army]] in various campaigns.<ref name="TEGTW" />

==History==
In addition to nineteen other [[Sector Army/Legends|sector armies]], the 17th [[Sector/Legends|Sector]] [[Army/Legends|Army]] was first activated by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] that marked the beginning of a [[civil war]]&mdash;known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]&mdash;between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] Rebellion.Throughout the duration of the War, the Seventeenth was [[Headquarters|headquartered]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vogel 7]] and charged with the defense of the [[Dustig Oversector]] [[Oversector/Legends|oversector]]. Like the other sector armies, the overall command of the Eighteenth was shared between a highly experienced [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] and a [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]] who was appointed by the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic. By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the last year of the Clone Wars, the Governor-Generals [[Sector Governance Decree/Legends|evolved]] into a permanent class of regional [[Governor/Legends|governors]] known as the [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

As the Clone Wars progressed, Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] promoted [[Lynch Hauser]] to the rank of Moff, giving him control of the Seventeenth Army and the [[Dustig Oversector]]. The 17th Sector Army supported the [[Eighteenth Army|18th Sector Army]] in many campaigns.

After the conclusion of the Clone Wars, the Old Republic's twenty sector commands, including the Seventeenth Army, were retained by the [[Declaration of a New Order|newly-risen]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Under the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine, Hauser ascended to the rank of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]]. Much of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]] was marked by the Empire's massive military buildup and resulted in a [[Imperial Military/Legends|vast army]] far larger than its [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic predecessor]]. Thus, the total infantry force of the Seventeenth Army and all other sector units were increased to approximately 1,572,864 troopers, most of whom were of natural birth as clones became marginalized into a minority status.<ref name="TEGTW" />
